INTRODUCTION

A trusted partner for quality food and memorable events

Introducing A.S Event and Caterers Co. — your trusted partner in delivering quality food and memorable events since 2023. We specialise in a wide range of delicious global cuisines, prepared with care and expertise by our team of chefs with over 30 years of combined experience.


At AS Event and Caterers Co., we believe that great taste and elegant experiences should be accessible to everyone. That's why we bring you luxury on a budget — offering exceptional service and flavorful dishes without compromising on quality.
